Then he climbed down, lit the lamp though the sky was clear, and wrote the names into the log where the relief boat would find them.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台刚关掉的机器。环路空着，红灯在没有车的路口一遍遍变，便利店的白光落在人行道上，收废品的三轮车慢慢蹬过去，铁皮碰出几声脆响。写字楼还有几格窗亮着，隔着玻璃看不出人在不在。早点铺开始和面，蒸笼还没上气。风从楼缝里穿过，带着夜里的凉。这个点醒着的人不多，各有各的理由，谁也不打扰谁。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job solves itself by doing a smaller piece of the same job first, like Russian dolls that open into smaller dolls.\n- Every recursion needs a stopping case, otherwise it keeps opening dolls forever and your program runs out of room.\n- A good test: count down from five by saying the number, then counting down from one less, and stop at zero."}
